research: Our own numbers (docs/reviews/2026-10-06.md, Oct 6 - Nov 4): statics ROAS 2.62 vs videos 1.58; the best ad is the pick-your-colour catalog static (S09, ROAS 2.93, 76 purchases); Julian 2026-11-05: make it for the Vintage Bag (4 colours: Ginger Brown, Black, Chocolate, Red on the site). So this batch is statics-first: 12, with the colours and value statics kept (rulebook keep_winners).

The account's #1 ad of the last 30 days is a 27 s closer (190-H3, docs/research/2026-11-winners-30d.md): the three videos are closers (format closer), each on a different lever: the one-hand clasp (223 good footage moments), the colours as a gift, the strap's two ways (209 moments). Warning hooks (all ten openings of 190 / 198 are warnings) and questions (52% hook rate in our export).

Earlier Vintage batches: B028 live test / friend advice / night before, B033 myth / gift / swap, B039-B040 friend advice, POV, four places; statics B029 used magazine_cover, pov_behind, feature_diagram, bold_poster, hang_tag, gift_moment, two_ways, colour_block, entryway_hook, B033 cafe_chair: none of those formats here; two new formats of our own (a felt letter board, a train ticket).

Facts used: 50% off (no gift), free shipping, the one-hand snap clasp, the organised inside (phone, wallet, keys each in a spot), the adjustable strap (handbag or crossbody), four colours; the sale ends 30 November; order by 14 December for the best chance of Christmas delivery. No warranty or price figures (none in the Vintage facts; the rulebook bans price figures).
